Coloring Page Maker

Turn any photo into a black-and-white coloring page using real Sobel edge detection — print and color it in.

Lower = more lines · higher = simpler.
Blurs before edge detection to reduce noise.

Real Sobel edge detection on your photo's pixels — nothing is uploaded, everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo (bold, simple subjects work best).
  2. Drag the detail threshold until the outlines look right.
  3. Optionally invert for white lines on black.
  4. Click "Download coloring page" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it make a coloring page?

The photo is converted to grayscale, then a Sobel filter finds edges (rapid brightness changes). Pixels above your threshold become black lines on white — like a coloring book.

The page is too detailed / too plain — how do I fix it?

Lower the threshold to keep more detail (more lines), raise it for a simpler page with bold outlines.

Is my photo uploaded?

Yes — edge detection runs on your photo's pixels in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
